name: invoice-ai-platform
description: Multi-tenant Invoice AI Platform - Complete solution for invoice extraction and management

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=server && npm install --workspace=client/admin && npm install --workspace=client/business
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:business"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:admin && npm run build:business
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:business"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client/admin && npm run lint --workspace=client/business
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client/admin && npm run lint --workspace=client/business
scripts.clean: npm run clean:server && npm run clean:admin && npm run clean:business
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run setup:env && npm run setup:server-env && npm run create-test-business
scripts.setup:env: npm run setup:env:admin && npm run setup:env:business
scripts.setup:env:admin: cd client/admin && [ ! -f .env ] && echo 'VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000/api/v1' > .env || echo 'Admin .env already exists'
scripts.setup:env:business: cd client/business && [ ! -f .env ] && echo 'VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000/api/v1' > .env || echo 'Business .env already exists'
scripts.setup:server-env: cd server && [ ! -f .env ] && cp ../.env.example .env && echo 'Server .env created from template - please configure your settings' || echo 'Server .env already exists'

author: Invoice AI Team
